rationale: The agent executed an exchange without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user asked to exchange both the keyboard (only if a clicky, RGB, full-size option exists) and the thermostat; the agent only processed the thermostat exchange without clarifying keyboard availability or confirming the user’s preference before proceeding. Although the agent appeared to use tools to identify the user and load order/product details, it did not present authentication confirmation to the user, nor did it verify the order belongs to the user in the conversation. The agent also stated a specific refund amount without showing tool-supported evidence in the transcript. Given the unconfirmed write and incomplete handling of the user’s full request, this fails the pass criteria.
